verdict.rationale: Omarchy wires a default AI agent into the desktop. Its own crash-notification flow sends that agent to examine crash dumps and diagnose what went wrong, which is AI-generated insight from the user's own data inside the product. That is a narrow, single use case, and the underlying agents are third-party harnesses (OpenCode, Claude Code). missing for 10: general AI insights or suggestions across user data beyond crash dumps, a first-party insight or suggestion feature, any documentation of how the diagnoses are surfaced, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: When an app crashes, click the notification to send your agent on the case. It can examine the crash dump, diagnose what went wrong, and help report the bug.
On first boot, Omarchy invites you to set up a default agent. Pick your favorite, sign in, and put it to work on your computer.
